explain.output:
## Meaning and nuance
This sentence informally asks if a meeting can be rescheduled to the next day because the speaker is stranded at the station. Written in a casual WhatsApp style, it uses everyday slang like *phãs gayā hū̃* and drops formal pronouns to sound like a quick text to a friend or colleague.

## Grammar
* Using the plural *kar lẽ* (कर लें - let's do) with *kyā* (क्या - question particle) softens a direct request into a casual suggestion.
* The locative suffix *pe* (पे - at/on) replaces the more formal *par* for a conversational, spoken feel.
* The state of being stuck is expressed with the participle *phãs gayā* (फँस गया) plus the auxiliary *hū̃* ( हूँ - am).

## Examples
* कल मिल लें क्या? (*Kal mil lẽ kyā?* - Shall we meet tomorrow?)
* मैं ट्रैफिक में फँस गया हूँ। (*Maĩ trafikal mẽ phãs gayā hū̃.* - I am stuck in traffic.)
* हम मीटिंग आगे बढ़ा दें क्या? (*Ham mītiṅg āge baṛhā dẽ kyā?* - Shall we postpone the meeting?)

## Verb forms
| Tense | Form (Masculine Singular) | Transliteration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Present | फँस गया हूँ | phãs gayā hū̃ |
| Past | फँस गया था | phãs gayā thā |
| Future | फँस जाऊँगा | phãs jāūṅgā |
